annotations.title: Add business days to a date (any country)

description: Return the date that falls N business days after a start date, skipping weekends and the country's public holidays. Use it for deadlines and delivery dates outside Chile; for Chilean legal deadlines use cl_dias_habiles. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /days/business-days via x402.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, DE, MX.

days.description: Number of business days to add.

from.description: Start Date as YYYY-MM-DD; default today. The start day is not counted.
